1.explanation:
To implement and document the new icon-only pattern, you’ll need:

• Tabs/Tabs.mdx – the primary documentation for Tabs that must describe both the line and contained icon-only variants.
• Tabs/next/Tabs.mdx – the next-release documentation branch where the new examples and prop tables will live.
• Tab/next/Tab.mdx – details on the Tab component API, since the icon-only variant will likely involve new props or styling at the Tab level.
• TabContent/TabContent.mdx – the example wrapper for the Tabs content pane, to ensure content alignment and sizing remain correct when only icons are used.
• Theme/next/Theme.mdx – to reference design tokens (spacing and sizing values) for the 48px container height and 20px icon sizing, ensuring consistency with the design system’s theme.
1.bug_scenario:
The issue is to introduce a new “icon-only” variant for both the “Line Tabs” and “Contained Tabs” patterns. In the provided screenshots:

• Contained Tabs – icon-only: each tab is rendered as a 48×48px square with a centered 20px-wide icon, a light gray background on inactive tabs, and a filled white/colored background on the active tab.

• Line Tabs – icon-only: each tab is a 48px-high inline element with no text label, only a 20px icon. Inactive tabs have no background and show a gray bottom border, while the active tab shows a colored bottom border under its icon.

Key UI elements involved:
– Tabs container (height, padding/spacers)
– Individual Tab (active vs. inactive styling)
– Icon placement and size (20px fixed width)
– Borders (bottom border for line variant)
– Background fill (for contained variant)
